description: A man in a steel helmet with a mail hauberk and a wooden kite shield on his back, with a sword at his hip, is bent over and drawing a wooden crossbow, its string held in a stirrup-style foot. Behind him a mounted knight in armour charges on a brown horse through smoke and dust. The ground is dark mud and the whole scene is an oil painting in dim browns and greys, edge to edge. There are no letters, no frame and no visible blood.
